operations.name: RPC call
operations.brief: A remote procedure call, such as an AWS SDK call or a gRPC call.
operations.otel_notes: OpenTelemetry names RPC spans `{rpc.method}`, falling back to `{rpc.system.name}` if `rpc.method` is unavailable or set to `_OTHER`. AWS SDK spans are named `{rpc.service}.{rpc.method}`, which the first template matches.
